caption: The drawing consists of a rectangular piece of needlework featuring various motifs stitched in red thread on a tan or beige fabric. The design is bordered by a red diamond lattice pattern along the left and bottom edges. Inside the border, the main section is filled with symmetrical floral and foliate patterns, including large central floral arrangements and additional ornamental flowers radiating outwards. In the upper left quadrant, there are two bird-like creatures facing opposite directions, stitched in red. The bottom left corner has a smaller section containing the text "DANIEL S & SALLY BUCK NE CATHARI 1844" stitched in red, surrounded by smaller floral motifs and framed by a partial border. The entire composition is executed in a cross-stitch technique, with only red thread used for all decorative and textual elements on the light background.
title: Handwoven Coverlet
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
